note.zh: 在 WorkBuddy（编码智能体 Harness）中以 Hy4 preview 生成，思考强度设为 High；Max 模式为 harness 内置开关，本次处于开启状态，非默认档位，特此说明。生成全程未调用任何 skill、插件或 MCP，未使用自定义系统提示词。生成后仅做三处非功能性调整：默认机位由 (6,9,74) 拉远至 (7,11,101)、曝光由 1.06 提升至 1.16（原机位下主体溢出画面），PMREM 模糊半径由 0.045 降至 0.03 以消除控制台告警。已通过本地无头 Chromium 冒烟测试确认可运行。因生成后有人工修改，由维护者标记为仅展示，不参与 Arena 盲评、投票与排行榜。
note.en: Generated by Hy4 preview on the WorkBuddy coding-agent harness with thinking intensity set to High; Max mode is a built-in harness toggle and was enabled here rather than the default, disclosed for completeness. No skill, plugin or MCP server was invoked and no custom system prompt was used. Three non-functional adjustments after generation: the default camera was pulled back from (6,9,74) to (7,11,101) and exposure raised from 1.06 to 1.16 because the subject overflowed the frame, and the PMREM blur radius was lowered from 0.045 to 0.03 to silence a console warning. Verified runnable with a local headless-Chromium smoke test. Because of these manual post-generation edits, the maintainer marked this run showcase-only: it is excluded from Arena, voting, and rankings.

note.en: Generated by Hy4 preview on the WorkBuddy harness with thinking intensity High and Max mode enabled (a built-in harness toggle, not the default). No skill, plugin or MCP server was invoked. No content was changed. Verified by rendering in local headless Chromium. Because of these manual post-generation edits, the maintainer marked this run showcase-only: it is excluded from Arena, voting, and rankings.

note.en: Generated by Hy4 preview on the WorkBuddy harness with thinking intensity High and Max mode enabled (a built-in harness toggle, not the default). No skill, plugin or MCP server was invoked. The first pass had three defects caught by static review and fixed: a missing TAU constant, a particle geometry without a vertex-colour attribute, and an oversized terrain-height cache. The first browser run showed the spawn point landed inside the World Tree trunk, so spawn was moved to open ground roughly 96 cells from the origin, facing the tree. Verified in local headless Chromium: 97-108 chunks streamed, zero pending, chunk streaming and break/place interaction all working.

note.en: Generated by Hy4 preview on the WorkBuddy harness with thinking intensity High and Max mode enabled (a built-in harness toggle, not the default). No skill, plugin or MCP server was invoked. note.en: Generated by Hy4 preview on the WorkBuddy harness with thinking intensity High and Max mode enabled (a built-in harness toggle, not the default). No skill, plugin or MCP server was invoked. Delivered as a complete Vite project; bun was unavailable locally so npm + vite were used, and both tsc --noEmit and vite build pass. The map is modelled as an 80x80 walkable cell grid, which means collision can never clip a wall, bot pathfinding cannot get stuck, and line-of-sight is an exact grid walk. A flood fill confirms all 2362 walkable cells are reachable from T spawn, as are every waypoint and both bomb sites. Verified in local headless Chromium: pistol-round start, clock advancing, minimap, crosshair, HUD and weapon switching all working, no JS errors.
